name: Draconic Mania
source:
A Distortion to meet in [i]A Case of Missing Identity.[/i] [b]Draconic Mania[/b] is a frantic being whose speaking style is almost a riddle in itself. It's hard to understand what he says when he speaks, but between the mad pacing and the frenetic energy he exudes, it almost feels like there's something deeper to him than meets the eye. Get closer to him, and this Distortion will speak of a strange junkyard where he and his kind fought to survive, just to make it to the city of Humans. Above all, though, there is one mysterious figure he sings the praises of: the Junkyard God.

As a character, [b]Draconic Mania[/b]'s cheery attitude holds a sadness in it that even he doesn't know is there. Speaking to him will push Perdita towards becoming a volatile heart, running toward the idea of a life where she can be happy. Even if it comes at the cost of ignoring her pains and agonies, his mindset of a world beyond his grasp will become hers.
